title: 西醫新法（[1872]；Bodleian Sinica 1826） / Xi yi xin fa [New methods of Western medicine]: Transcription dataset
description:
《西醫新法》（Xi yi xin fa）是一部討論外科與包紮的晚清漢譯醫學文獻，署「美國嘉約翰口譯」「莆田林湘東筆述」；Bodleian Libraries館藏Sinica 1826的官方固定書目供定刊地[Canton]、年代[1872]。本資料集以該館數位影像為底本，提供六面圖版、三十七面正文及一面原框正文空白面的原印文字初錄，並以TXT、JSON及TEI XML保存文字、疑讀與物理面／影像幀對應，供晚清外科與包紮漢譯詞彙、圖文關係及印刷史研究。本版為保留疑讀的AI初錄，尚未經人類全文雙校或專家審定。

Xi yi xin fa [New methods of Western medicine] is a late-Qing Chinese medical work concerning surgery and bandaging, credited to John Glasgow Kerr (嘉約翰) for oral translation and Lin Xiangdong (林湘東) for written rendering. The official fixed catalogue for Bodleian Libraries, Sinica 1826, supplies [Canton] and [1872]. Derived from the Bodleian digital images, this dataset offers an initial transcription of original printed text across six figure faces, thirty-seven main-text faces, and one face with an original printed frame and a blank body. TXT, JSON, and TEI XML retain readings, uncertainties, and physical-face-to-image mappings for research on late-Qing surgical and bandaging terminology in translation, image-text relationships, and print history. This is an AI initial transcription with uncertainty records; full human double collation and expert review have not been performed.
notes: Source: https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/objects/d07550d1-b969-4d5a-a5f3-5bd10634b21c/ IIIF: https://iiif.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/iiif/manifest/d07550d1-b969-4d5a-a5f3-5bd10634b21c.json Official fixed catalogue: https://github.com/bodleian/east-asian-mss/blob/c177d5a6db8585168b744d38a6bff02186d1968f/collections/chinese/Sinica%201826.xml Formats: TXT, JSON, TEI XML; scope: 25 captures, 44 numbered physical faces (six figure faces, 37 main-text faces, one original-frame/blank-body face); four cover surfaces excluded. Historical public-domain text and faithful mechanical transcription acquire no new exclusive restriction. Copyrightable original documentation and arrangement: CC BY 4.0. Bodleian images are excluded and separately carry CC BY-NC 4.0. The English bracketed title is an editorial translation. GitHub repository: https://github.com/poplolioi11/bodleian-sinica1826-xiyi-xinfa-1872. Zenodo archival is pending; version and concept DOIs have not been assigned.
methods: AI-assisted initial image transcription, preserving literal frozen strings, source-side locators and uncertainties. Viewed source marginal regions with uncertain text or page assignment remain separately documented with unknown extent; this does not mean that all such text is illegible or that every original character has been transcribed. An independent image reading has not been applied to this version. Full human double collation, expert review, peer review and accuracy measurement have not been performed. Exact model, effort and token figures are unknown. Structural, checksum, schema and export-equivalence checks assess engineering properties only. Original dots may be printed or later additions; this distinction has not been human-verified. Source images, crops, private programs, prompts and full private provenance are not distributed; a complete image-to-text reproduction method is not provided. Historical-document research only; no clinical validation or biological research is claimed.
